remaining_decision.reason: Current evidence identifies expensive fresh Host validation and repeated full graph traversal, but does not establish a new small implementation preserving every live boundary with a reliable tail improvement.
already_present: KernelBudget::check fresh boot, parent symlink metadata and calling-thread membership, followed by all five complete current limit reads in original order.
Immutable path names, short stack-buffer reads, complete EOF/UTF-8/error handling and current-byte numeric validation already exist.
NodeReader prepares one SELECT for a graph, decodes the borrowed actual Blob and resets its cursor before callbacks; no per-node prepare or owned Vec copy remains to remove.
PostWriteReadback has original four-record whole-Root and bounded same-writer frontier reuse; complete State/Record checks and terminal fences remain.
rejected_not_restarted: Prepared Host paths/current-limit text: retained 16-ABBA decision median 0.9029464037, empirical p95 1.4171393114, declared p95 limit 1.05.
Ordered sibling SQL: rejected before runtime because left-arm execution may precede the original right-side verdict.
unsafe_shortcuts_not_proposed: Caching successful Host authorization/limits/membership, retaining live descriptors across checks, treating a short read as EOF, reducing checkpoint frequency or widening original CPU/deadline budgets.
Importing receiver W1 or authorization receipts into an independent History owner.
Using successful Root equality across implicit or distinct SQLite transactions as evidence of current node availability.

concrete_next_measurement.placement: Optional bounded Host subphase observer around existing operations in host_kernel_parent.rs::KernelBudget::check, connected to the existing HistoryImportObserver; default disabled.
concrete_next_measurement.requirements: Preserve exact operation/error order, fresh opens, every native/Host checkpoint, original deadlines and CPU settlement. Include failed/cancelled/unfinished calls and unknown clocks. Do not hide instrumentation cost or emit per-check unbounded logs.
concrete_next_measurement.missing_denominator: Current Host aggregate cannot separate procfs, sysfs, metadata, parser and observer overhead; it also combines invoking threads. A fixed per-calling-thread importer-vs-worker split is needed before subtracting it from importer-only phases.
concrete_next_measurement.required_environment: Original administrator-provisioned fixed cgroup parent with the same kernel/filesystem/profile and unchanged limits; five ordinary temporary files do not qualify the sysfs Host path.
concrete_next_measurement.status: Design only; no implementation or old negative rerun.

larger_dependency.gap: Existing receipt accepts only one actual main WRITE transaction and invalidates on any executed potential write/transaction ABA. General read-path reuse first needs an explicit immutable read-snapshot capability and complete schema/current-State/current-record/final-consumed fencing, with external-writer and callback mutation negatives.
larger_dependency.limit: This is a separate architectural proof obligation, not a ready change obtained by relaxing same_write_snapshot or reusing a Node-local validity cache.

scope_findings: All four small pressure phases have seven receiver ACKs but zero independent confirmation; baseline-only success is not original pressure success.

F0 baseline has nine imports, eight native successes and one deadline refusal. The valid-work-root phase has zero History fetches/imports and only three timely ACKs from fifteen attempts; import-zero cannot identify the upstream blockage as solved.

F0 client account_graph delta is 4.120934468 seconds for the phase-wide client snapshot; the 5.577814982-second page.history_import CPU has a different interval boundary. No graph/import share is calculated.

The three-run thirty-second campaign has 27 planned confirmations and only three observed inside the original windows; all three are baseline. All failed, late and unattempted planned work remains in the denominator.
F0 and thirty-second RPC caller CPU is process-wide. Four-second RPC caller CPU and native importer phase CPU are thread-local. Do not compare or subtract those as identical CPU scopes.
HEAD and merge have the same source tree but substantially different per-Host timing; no code speedup or architecture attribution follows from that cross-lane difference.
The fixed after-snapshots exclude the final standalone read_active; they still include confirmation/internal reads in addition to imports.
No cheapest-work, public-readiness, stable p95/p99, independent operator, WAN or production-activation claim follows.
